title: Improved Techniques for Training Consistency Models
summary: Consistency models are a nascent family of generative models that can sample high quality data in one step without the need for adversarial training.
body: Consistency models are a nascent family of generative models that can sample high quality data in one step without the need for adversarial training.
summaryZh: OpenAI发布了关于改进一致性模型（Consistency Models）训练技术的最新进展。一致性模型是一类新兴的生成式模型家族，能够在无需对抗性训练的情况下实现高质量数据的单步采样。该技术优化了训练方法，有望进一步加快生成式AI的推理速度。
